intro: Troll Charms are sacred spiritual amulets carried by the Darkspear trolls. A collection of them was recently looted by hostile Thistlefur furbolgs after an ambush along the northern reaches of Ashenvale.

p: To the trolls of the Horde, spiritual charms are far more than mere ornamentation. As the scout Mitsuwa explains, a troll without their charm is considered as diminished as an orc without battle scars. When a party of Darkspear kin journeyed toward Zoram'gar Outpost through the dense canopy of Ashenvale, they were ambushed and slaughtered by the corrupted Thistlefur furbolgs. While their spirits were commended to the afterlife, the furbolgs looted the dead and carried off their sacred charms as trophies, stashing them in chests deep within Thistlefur Hold.
